rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something happened fortunately.

example.english: I luckily brought an umbrella, so I didn't get soaked by the rain.
example.traditional: 好彩我帶咗遮，冇畀雨淋親。
example.jyutping: hou2 coi2 ngo5 daai3 zo2 ze1 mou5 bei2 jyu5 lam4 can1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing relief that a bad outcome was avoided or a helpful circumstance came to the rescue.

example.english: Luckily, the bus hadn't left yet, so we made it in time.
example.traditional: 好在架巴士未開，我哋趕得切。
example.jyutping: hou2 zoi6 gaa3 baa1 si2 mei6 hoi1 ngo5 dei6 gon2 dak1 cit3
